description: JPS by BookLikeJoël lets connected members search live award-flight availability, review mileage-program results, and manage private JPS flight watches from ChatGPT. JPS does not book, hold, reserve, or issue tickets, and it never fabricates live inventory, mileage prices, taxes, seat counts, schedules, airlines, or booking links.
